description: The StartupControlPanel class manages high-level startup, shutdown, and initialization procedures for the OFBiz server, including loading configurations, starting/stopping containers, handling shutdown hooks, and logging setup.

classes.name: StartupControlPanel
classes.description: A final class that orchestrates the startup, shutdown, and initialization processes of the OFBiz server, including configuration loading, container management, and shutdown handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes OFBiz by setting system properties and creating a configuration object based on user commands.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the startup sequence for OFBiz, including loading containers, setting shutdown hooks, and printing startup messages or shutting down if configured.

methods.name: fullyTerminateSystem
methods.description: Handles significant startup errors by printing the error, executing shutdown hooks, and exiting with a failure code.

methods.name: shutdownServer
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server by unloading containers and updating server state.

methods.name: loadGlobalOfbizSystemProperties
methods.description: Loads system properties from a specified properties file into JVM system properties.

methods.name: createLogDirectoryIfMissing
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not exist, and logs its creation.

methods.name: loadContainers
methods.description: Loads container modules for OFBiz, synchronized to prevent concurrent modification, and updates server state accordingly.
